english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an investigation or inquiry process.
Use 調查 as the all-purpose noun for a general or official investigation or inquiry.

examples.english: We’re still carrying out an investigation, and there are no results yet.
examples.traditional: 我哋仲做緊調查，未有結果。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung6 zou6 gan2 diu6 caa4 mei6 jau5 git3 gwo2

examples.english: The police probe still has no result.
examples.traditional: 警方嗰次調查仲未有結果。
examples.jyutping: ging2 fong1 go2 ci3 diu6 caa4 zung6 mei6 jau5 git3 gwo2
